title: New Bloom Blessings

outfit_card.silhouette: A two-piece festive ensemble featuring a quilted golden vest with plush white fur trim layered over voluminous cream brocade sleeves, paired with a straight crimson ceremonial skirt. A cream hooded bonnet adds top-heavy volume.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A plush white bonnet with colorful auspicious floral embroidery, bordered in a thick furry tuft, complete with dangling jade-like beads and gold tassels.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Golden brocade vest with a plush white fur hem and collar, worn over cream sleeves adorned with intricate red and gold scrolling embroidery, fastened with a large red knot button and tassel.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A straight, floor-length crimson skirt featuring a central gold vertical panel with geometric brocade trim and a festive goldfish motif near the hem, grounding the look with traditional gravity.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: A gold openwork metal sticker held aloft, depicting an auspicious character, accompanied by a small dangling jade pendant tied with an emerald green tassel.
